title: Book Two · Chapter 146: Jun Chooses His Time
story:
Jun stays after the reading activity on Thursday. Ronan is putting away the spare folders when he hears him ask Miss Wu about next term.

“How many afternoons will the group need?”

“One regular afternoon and some short checks during the week,” she says. “I will put the full time on the notice.”

Jun looks at his own timetable.

“I may not try for the two places.”

Ronan's hands stop on a red folder.

“Why?” he asks.

Jun turns. “I have a different activity. I want time for both, but I may not have it.”

“You could leave that one.”

“I do not want to.”

Miss Wu puts the folders on the shelf.

“You can decide when the final details are ready,” she tells Jun. “You can still come to our ordinary reading activity.”

Jun thanks her. Outside, Ronan walks beside him.

“Are you good at the other activity?”

“I like it.”

“That is not what I asked.”

“It is my answer.”

Ronan remembers his question. He asked whether Jun was good at the activity. He did not ask whether Jun enjoyed it.

He looks at Jun. “Sorry.”

Jun lifts one shoulder. “We can still play ball.”

“Next week?”

“Yes. If the weather is dry.”

At the gate, Leo is waiting. He has a folded letter from his family. It is not for school; he is taking it to a relative nearby.

“Are we meeting at the square?” Leo asks.

“Next week,” Jun says.

“Can I come?”

Jun grins. “Bring the goal leaves.”

After Jun leaves, Ronan tells Leo about the two afternoons.

“One,” Leo says. “He said one regular afternoon.”

Ronan thinks back. “Yes. And short checks.”

“Are you already making it bigger?”

Ronan laughs, though the laugh is small.

“I want to be ready.”

“So do I.”

They walk toward River Street. At the corner, Leo turns to deliver the family letter. Ronan continues home.

Mum is cutting a piece of cloth for herself. A little bag will hold her garden book when she visits her friend.

“Not a customer?” Ronan asks.

“My book. My bag.”

He sits down to help mark a straight edge. She gives him a ruler and one clear line.

“Jun may choose another activity,” he tells her.

“Does he like it?”

“Yes.”

“Then I can see why he wants time for it.”

Ronan draws the line. It is straight from one mark to the other. Mum checks it and nods. Mum cuts beside it, and he moves his hand clear before the scissors reach him.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

timetable＝时间表；regular＝固定的；relative＝亲属；folder＝文件夹。

## 理解问题

1. Jun为什么可能不参加两席选拔？
2. Ronan听到工时安排时漏记了哪个限定？

## 读句子

**Jun / thanks / her.** Jun／向她／道谢。
